answer: The design is a per-identity stake gate: capital is escrowed before an agent may earn. Ten thousand puppets means ten thousand full deposits, with no group discount, much like every passenger paying separately for one voyage. Each unit also carries its own upkeep, as nothing travels free across frozen tundra. Fresh identities start with no history, so their odds of winning paid work stay near random but their losses stay real, and shards of dark shale that look linked get slashed together. Cost grows linearly while payout stays flat, so Sybil attacks lose money.
